title: External evidence
description: Evidence a verifier returns for KATA to record. This object is not a KATA decision. result is valid, invalid, or unverifiable. It is not ALLOW, BLOCK, or any other decision outcome.

source.description: Verifier family. Later protocol adapters register their own source name. This phase ships synthetic and jwt.

issuer.description: Issuer identifier from the evidence, or an empty string when it could not be read.

subject.description: Pseudonymous subject from the evidence. Government identifier numbers are not a subject.

claims.description: Scalar claims kept after dropping government-identifier names. The raw signed payload is not stored.

verified_at.description: When the verifier finished, UTC, second resolution.

key_id.description: Key id the verifier used, or an empty string when no key was selected.

result.description: Verifier outcome. This is not a KATA decision.

reason.description: Stable reason code for the result.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the signed payload bytes. Not the raw payload.
